name: Geo Settings

fields.label: Active boundary dataset
fields.description: The polygon dataset used by resolve_point / resolve_area. Leave empty to disable offline admin resolution.

fields.label: Active gazetteer dataset
fields.description: The point dataset used for nearest-place lookup.

fields.label: Border tolerance (m)
fields.description: Points within this distance of a boundary get flagged as ambiguous.

fields.label: Max STRtree cache entries per worker
Enable online geocoder fallback
fields.description: Off by default. When enabled, the server may call the configured provider only when local resolution fails and the user explicitly requests it.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Per-release provider choice — review the provider's ToS and data licence before enabling.

fields.label: Cache online results (days)
fields.description: Online results are cached locally and PII is stripped; set to 0 to disable caching.

fields.label: Nearest-place max distance (m)
fields.description: Do not return a village/gazetteer match farther than this from the point.

fields.label: Ambiguity threshold (m)
fields.description: If two candidates are closer than this to each other and to the point, return both flagged as ambiguous.

fields.label: Default country code
fields.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 / alpha-3; narrows searches when no polygon matches.

fields.label: Sea/gap warning distance (km)
fields.description: Points this far from any land polygon are flagged as 'over water / no boundary'.

description: Site-wide settings for administrative auto-fill, offline boundary/gazetteer datasets and online fallback.
